source.name: the-sports.org Women's European Championship 2026 + Wikipedia knockout round
source.method: Hosted page fetch of public results tables. Set scores transcribed as printed. Incomplete set lines are flagged, never reconstructed.

notes: This tape is EuroVolley women 2026 only. It is never joined to NCAA college volleyball.
Germany 3-0 Hungary on 25 August is listed with an incomplete set line (25-17, 7-4); the match counts as a win/loss but set-score components are not scored from it.
Belgium vs Spain 22 August is not in this tape: the published 3-2 listing disagrees with the printed fifth-set score.
Head-to-head between Poland and the Netherlands inside this tournament is empty as of the quarter-finals; VNL meetings are not invented here.

matches.note: Printed set line is incomplete (25-17, 7-4). Result 3-0 is used for win/loss form only.
Wikipedia lists Netherlands 3-2 Slovenia on 31 August. Individual set points were not transcribed from that page.
